name: formify-pdf-forms
title_zh: 静态 PDF 变成能填能签的表单模板
tagline_zh: 手里只有一份盖章版合同 PDF，不想重排也不想求设计，它能识别出该填哪儿、把死文字换成可填字段，再压上签名位。
tagline_en: You have a stamped contract PDF and no layout budget. It finds what should be filled, swaps dead text for real.
desc_en: Build fillable PDF forms and contract templates with signature fields. Use when creating a form or template, adding fillable fields to an existing PDF, replacing static text with fields, or preparing a document for e-signing. why_zh: 不是套一层白框盖住原文，而是把静态文字真正替换成字段，所以填写、校验、签名都落在 PDF 原生结构里。
why_en: It replaces static text with real fields instead of overlaying white boxes, so filling, validation and signing live in the PDF's.
limit_zh: 只做表单与模板，不负责发送、催签和归档；扫描件或纯图片 PDF 没有文字层，得先自己 OCR。
